description: The can function with an argument expanded from an unknown tuple gives the dynamic value
notes: The README says can gives a bool, and the spec doesn't say how an unknown value expands (native/unknowns/function-expand-unknown-tuple): the tuple's type gives one element, an unknown number, which can would take as a successful expression, giving a bool rather than the dynamic value. hashicorp/hcl returns the dynamic value for an expanded argument that is unknown, before calling the function (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
